openQuestions: Authoritative GIS/manual tracing is still needed for fine-grained morphology-zone boundaries, the Guadalmedina corridor and exact landscape/shoreline POI geometries.
Current facade/balcony/roof sampling remains incomplete for ordinary Carretera de Cádiz/Cruz de Humilladero apartment stock and for later Pedregalejo–El Palo infill.

The La Palmilla walk-up subtype is source-supported, but current block-by-block rehabilitation/facade condition and the full mix of neighboring taller/other estate forms require dated visual sampling.
The Avenida de Andalucía tower-on-podium lineage is structurally clear, but its exact corridor distribution and representative storey/material bands require systematic mapping.
Eastern hillside/garden-villa site grammar is stronger after review, but current roof/material distribution in Cerrado, Pinares and Candado remains unresolved.
Port operational buildings and industrial/logistics sheds remain intentionally generalized; current parcel-by-parcel occupancy should be rechecked with dated orthophoto before production freeze.
Málaga TechPark core is established, but extension/imec/data-centre projects are time-sensitive construction/future-state layers and must be rechecked before production freeze.
The current airport terminal is established, while the DORA III expansion remains future state; future geometry must not replace the present terminal until built and verified.

The Guadalmedina integration project remained at design-contract stage in August 2026; current city representation should preserve the existing hydraulic channel/barrier until works are actually completed.
Cathedral roof/fronton construction remained in progress in 2026 with expected completion at end-2027; a later review is needed for post-works appearance.
